title: Characterization of multiplication encodings
statement: For any bit strings $a,b,c$, the nested pair encoding $\langle a,\langle b,c\rangle\rangle$ belongs to the language of encoded products if and only if each of $a,b,c$ is empty or ends in $1$, and the little-endian binary values of these words satisfy $\operatorname{val}(c)=\operatorname{val}(a)\operatorname{val}(b)$, where $\operatorname{val}(w_0\cdots w_{n-1})=\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}w_i2^i$.
hypotheses_covered: Bit strings a, b, and c
